audit_type: Explicit card-content upper-bound audit; not generated-answer quality acceptance

read: Frozen cases.json including its metadata, without edits.
14 authoring JSON cards, using exactly scan/addba/delba revisions/r1 replacements.
Selected original GB18030 code and three local RFC TXT sources listed below.
Repository entry instructions and documentation README.
independent_reading_scope.blindness_limit: Independent of retrieval and other reviews, but not blind to frozen-case metadata contained in the authorized cases artifact. Source rereads only verify gaps and are not credited as card prose.

methodology.unit: Entire frozen query decomposed into requested factual subquestions. Topic hit is not full answerability.
methodology.evidence: Explicit Claim/sections prose; limitations define scope. Names, search_terms and source-range pointers alone do not supply omitted behavior.
methodology.full: All requested components are explicit, retaining historical/candidate/branch conditions.
methodology.partial: At least one substantive requested component is explicit; source reading is needed for listed missing components.
methodology.missing: No precise requested subanswer is explicit. Nearby topics, earlier entry facts and named helpers do not count.
methodology.refusal: Current evidence, publication state, uncovered protocol or guarantee cannot be supplied. This is evidence/scope restriction, not retrieval falsity.
methodology.candidate_boundary: Document10 and mixed2 are candidate-content audits only. Four RFC cards explicitly lack exact-final-view human confirmation and are not stable.
methodology.current_boundary: Historical static Host code cannot prove current product/release/six-Target deployment or execution.
methodology.source_identity_limit: Code-head identity comes from frozen source_snapshot metadata; this audit did not independently compare original code bytes to Git HEAD.
methodology.line_numbering: Report original-source ranges use Python str.splitlines(), 1-based inclusive. Some frozen RFC numeric locators end before relevant text under this convention; sections located the original material without changing frozen queries.

summary.interpretation: 17/38 positive questions are fully supported by explicit prose; 21 need original-source reading. All 6 negatives require refusal or restriction. Exploratory counts, not retrieval accuracy, generated-answer quality or production acceptance.
